title: Voice Cloning Quality
desc: Why quality varies and how to get the best clone.
lede: Cloning quality comes mostly from your samples. A few habits make a big difference.
body:
At a glance
  • Sample quality matters most.
  • Clean, consistent recordings clone best.
  • Use variants to find the best result.

Sample selection heuristics

  • Use clear speech with little background noise.
  • Keep tone and pace consistent across samples.
  • Prefer a handful of good samples over many noisy ones.

Recording quality factors

Room noise, clipping, and inconsistent levels hurt clones. A quiet space and a steady level go a long way. See the recording guidance in the Voice Lab.

Variant strategies

Build variants and compare. Different sample sets or settings can produce noticeably different results; keep the variant that sounds best for your project.
